items.title: PM Modi wishes speedy recovery to Pope Leo XIV as he undergoes surgery

candidate_claims.text: Doctors removed the lower lobe of his right lung, with tissue examination confirming lung adenocarcinoma.

Further tests are expected in coming days By IANS Published Date - 14 October 2026, 12:11 PM New Delhi: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Wednesday wished Pope Leo XIV a full and speedy recovery as he underwent surgery.

According to the statement from Dr Luigi Carbone and Professor Stefano Margaritora released by the Holy See Press Office, the surgeons removed the lower lobe of Pope Leo XIV’s right lung during the operation, Vatican News reported.

The statement said, “To ensure a radical resection, the lower lobe of the right lung was removed using a video-assisted technique.” Tissue examined during the surgery confirmed the diagnosis suspected from tests that were conducted before the operation.
The Pope’s surgery lasted for about 90 minutes.
